text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Fire raged through one of Mozambique's biggest markets, Xipamanine in Maputo, destroying at least 150 stalls in the early hours of Wednesday morning. Large quantities of food and other items for sale were lost but there were no reports of casualties.

- The Southern African Development Community (SADC) theatre festival will be held in Maputo from June 21 to 27. Of the 12 SADC member states, only Zambia and Tanzania have not confirmed that they will participate. The festival should have been held last October, but was postponed because of lack of funds.
